lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gills. These are arranged in approximately four horizontal rows, with the central clusters showing the highest diameter and intensity. The arrangement follows a semi-regular staggered pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal bands to form a lattice. High-intensity circular blobs are precisely centered at these grid intersections, particularly in the mid-lateral region posterior to the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from light pixels on the dorsal edge to a dark shadow on the ventral edge. A second, less distinct ridge runs parallel below it.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep vertical linear indentation, indicative of a healed laceration or significant tissue trauma, is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, extending ventrally towards the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a high density of small, irregularly sized high-luminance clusters, which transition to a significantly lower density and larger spot size at the pectoral-to-flank boundary.
